_README.purpose: Values transcribed by reading each document image directly, NOT copied from extractor output. Copying extractor output would make the file circular: a wrong-but-well-formed value would be enshrined as truth and could never be detected.
_README.fields: Assertable. Printed on the document AND legible in this image, so extraction is expected to recover it.
_README.not_asserted: True of the document but NOT recoverable from this image (masked on the card, or cropped out of frame). Recorded for context; asserting these would penalise extraction for pixels that are not there.
_README.ambiguous: The document carries more than one equally-valid value for the field, so no single expected value exists.
_README.dates: ISO yyyy-mm-dd. Indian ID documents print dd/mm/yyyy.
_README.names: As printed. Comparison is case-insensitive but space-sensitive, so a dropped space counts as wrong.
